To get the best experience, here are a few quick tips for beginners:
• Sizing & Fit: Aim for a comfortably snug fit when you first put them on. Natural leather and linen soften and mold to your feet, stretching about half a size where needed. You can test your fit by removing the Carbon Step™ insole and standing on it—if your toes fit neatly inside its outline, you have the right size!
